---
name: Coverage proposal
about: Propose a bounded addition to observation scope, taxonomy, source coverage, or public metadata
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Observation gap or user need
Describe the concrete missing coverage without assuming a conclusion.

## Proposed scope
Define the entities, source classes, time window, taxonomy, or repository surface to add or refine.

## Source basis
List representative primary/official/original-research sources and explain why they are appropriate.

## Analytical boundary
State what the proposed coverage can establish and what remains outside scope, including capability testing or benchmark reproduction.

## Acceptance criteria
Define observable criteria for sufficient coverage, source quality, date calibration, and uncertainty handling.

## Non-goals and risks
Identify selection bias, source asymmetry, duplicated signals, or other interpretation risks.
